package.name: Meanwhile
package.description: Circles of characters whose lives go on while you are away, on a clock you can speed up or set. Each finished day gets a few short events, a diary line per character and hooks that the characters bring up in chat. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Meanwhile.
